summary: Tested new features: in-app notifications, data-entry hours meter, dashboard 'recent ticket updates' panel. Backend: 9 new pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_notifications_hours.py all pass (dashboard field presence, hours math + clamping, admin ticket update creates a notification, no-op update does NOT create a notification, mark single/read-all, company-scoped isolation). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: logged in as Robin, hours meter shows on both Dashboard and Data-Entry page (0/10), created a new ticket (appeared as ticket-card), opened it in /admin-control-241, set status Done + admin note, saved. Back on dashboard: unread badge shows count '2' (2 unread including our new one), dashboard-ticket-updates panel shows the ticket with the note and 'done' status badge as the top row, notification-panel opens with items including the correct message, 'Mark all read' clears the badge. All acceptance criteria met.

minor.issue: Passing a non-ObjectId string (e.g. 'xxx') raises bson.InvalidId -> 500 instead of 400/404. Prior iteration flagged the same on /api/admin/data-entry-tickets/{id}; the admin route now returns 404 correctly, but notification read/read-all should also guard invalid ids.

recent_ticket_updates is sorted by updated_at, but every new ticket already gets updated_at on create. So the panel can display tickets that have NEVER been touched by admin (no status change, no admin_notes). Consider filtering to tickets where admin_notes exists OR status != 'open' so 'Data-entry updates' truly reflects admin activity.

issues: The static caption '1015 hrs requested this membership term' beneath the meter appears hardcoded (does not match data_hours_used which is 1015 here only because a test bumped it). It reads oddly when used >> total. Consider a friendlier phrase such as 'X hrs requested (over your Y-hr plan)'.

action_items: (Minor) Add ObjectId validation / try-except to POST /api/notifications/{nid}/read (return 400 on bad id).
(Minor) Filter recent_ticket_updates to only tickets that have been touched by admin (e.g. admin_notes present or status != 'open').
(Cosmetic) Fix the 'X hrs requested this membership term' subtitle wording when used > total.
critical_code_review_comments: create_notification helper and admin_update_ticket integration are clean; message is generated only when status changed or admin_notes actually changed (delta check present) - good.
Notification list uses sort by _id desc which is essentially insertion order via ObjectId time bits - acceptable proxy for created_at.
GET /api/notifications limits to 50 and is company_id-scoped; POST read-all is also company-scoped - verified by cross-company test.
Hours math and clamp are correct: remaining = max(total - used, 0), rounded to 1 decimal.
NotificationBell polls every 15s which is fine but could be replaced with SSE/WebSocket later; not blocking.
